items.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock Looks Overvalued After Its 149% 5 Year Run

With the valuation lens firmly on its cash flows, the question is how well those future streams of money line up with the current market price. The collaboration allows business travelers using Spotnana to access Marriott rates, room availability, and loyalty benefits through a single booking flow.
